role: Marker interface joining ITextureObject and ITickable: a texture object that ticks once per client tick. The only implementor in this game is TextureMap (the block/item atlas).
notes: The native renderer has no texture-object registry: it samples pre-stitched atlas dumps (csrc/engine/raster_texture.c, csrc/assets). The per-tick texture animation this interface enables lives in TextureClock/TextureCompass/TextureMap, which have their own records. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: An interface joining ITextureObject and ITickable; its only implementer, TextureMap, ticks the animated sprites that csrc/engine/texanim.c ports. No behaviour of its own.
